items.organizationName: TR-CERT (Computer Emergency Response Team of the Republic of Türkiye)
items.scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to cirosec researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
EA issues only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Hitachi Energy products only.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
openHarmony issues only.
StrongDM issues only.
SailPoint issues only.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Vulnerabilities related to TCS-CERT’s customers’ environment and vulnerabilities related to research conducted by Cyber Solutions by Thales’ Intrusion and Application Security Team.
All IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Building Technology - Video Systems) products including end-of-life products.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.

Vulnerabilities affecting the products, their security-relevant components, and functionality developed and maintained by companies within the EasyVista Group, including:

OTRS - OTRS and features developed and maintained by OTRS GmbH; OTRS container distribution bundle, including container images customized, configured, or maintained by OTRS GmbH; OTRS SaaS and platform components developed and operated by OTRS GmbH; and security-relevant functionality and integrations developed and maintained by OTRS GmbH.

EasyVista - EV Service Manager; EV Service Apps; EV Self Help; EV Observe; EV Digital Experience Monitoring; EV Reach; and EV Discovery.
Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Adobe issues only.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
JetBrains products only.
Supported Secomea products only.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
Okta issues only.
Fuji Xerox and FUJIFILM Business Innovation products such as multifunction devices, printers, production printers, software, and cloud services.
Zyxel products issues only.
Vulnerabilities in all Ubiquiti products and products of Ubiquiti subsidiaries only.
ABB issues only.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
Synology issues only.
Zscaler issues only.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
Proton AG issues only.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
Products, services, and solutions developed by Canon EMEA, Canon USA Inc., and those from IRIS, NT-ware, Onyx Graphics Inc., and Therefore Corporation, which are not under the Canon Brand.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
Flock branded hardware and software products only.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
